item.title: Can my laptop stand in for Claude Haiku?
item.description: I set up a local AI model on my laptop's integrated graphics and gave it the basics a cloud model has: today's date, web search, a view of the computer it runs on, and a memory. It works and nothing leaves the machine unless it searches, but a web question takes two minutes. Here's the setup, what slowed it down, and where I'd use it.

item.title: I gave an AI agent an old laptop board and a Discord server
item.description: My first try at a personal AI agent on a Raspberry Pi was more hassle than it was worth. My second, Hermes on a spare Framework mainboard, now runs my lights, music, plants, newsletter and a lot of my day. Here's how it's set up, what it saves me, and the rules I keep it on.
